required: an asynchronous operation that affects the user exposes a perceptible pending/loading state when latency is material
pending/loading must not be conveyed by animation or color alone
use determinate progress only when completed work can be meaningfully measured against a known total
indeterminate loading must not fabricate percentage or completion precision
loading should preserve useful context when technically and semantically possible
completion must resolve to an explicit outcome rather than leave stale pending state
forbidden: treating a spinner as determinate progress
inventing percentage completion without measurable total
stale pending state after success or failure
using didactic journey progress as proof of data-loading progress

promotionRule: QUALIFIED is permitted only after immutable evidence receipts, fail-closed validation and independent exact-head review all PASS. STABLE remains forbidden in Stage A.2. Runtime adoption requires separately governed Stage B.
